_readme: Hand-checked properties with a known outcome. scripts/backtest-arv.ts re-scores each on every run with the current engine. condition 'remodeled' is checked against the ARV, 'clean' (maintained, not remodeled) against the as-is value. status 'pending' is an accepted offer, not a sale: reported as a supporting fact only, never counted in accuracy or used to tune.
